authority: Author requested an audit of Manufactured stock, revisions to names/descriptions, and proposals rather than deletion for nonqualifying items.
criterion: A retained stock entry identifies a tangible selected, processed or shaped material form that is prepared for further fabrication. It may be a powder, feed grade, billet, blank, sheet, strip, length or unfitted composite. A name alone does not establish craft readiness, a production recipe or service performance. Unqualified byproducts, finished animal feed, recovered discrete parts and redundant umbrella entries require separate review.
scope: Local catalog editorial iteration. Preserve item IDs, categories, tiers, quantities, recipe topology, review/art choices and Unity source definitions. Proposed descriptions do not install mechanics or establish material ratings. World identity, streaming/unload/reload, generated-object identity, authored placement and persisted runtime deltas are not applicable because no world/runtime content changes.

decisions.previousDescription: The coarse granular fraction left by dry sorting Ironstone. Its larger pieces form a separate stock from the sand, mineral fines and iron-rich concentrate; downstream uses and recovery yields remain to be designed.
decisions.name: Coarse Aggregate
decisions.description: The coarse granular fraction left by dry sorting Ironstone. Its larger pieces form a separate stock from the sand, mineral fines and iron-rich concentrate; downstream uses and recovery yields remain to be designed.
decisions.reason: An authored dry-sorting byproduct with Primary use still unresolved, rather than a defined fabrication stock grade. A proposed beetle-feed ingredient link alone does not establish a stock application. Preserve the existing Unity variant and dry-sort recipe until a separate decision defines relocation or removal.

decisions.previousDescription: The iron-rich fraction separated during dry sorting of Ironstone. It concentrates candidate metal-bearing feed for later refining, without implying that sorting has already produced usable iron metal.
decisions.name: Sorted Ironstone concentrate
decisions.description: Iron-bearing granules separated from Ironstone by the existing dry-sorting process. This concentrated mineral fraction is feed for later metal refining; it has not yet been reduced to usable iron. Its Ironstone source distinguishes it from the separately proposed selected iron-ore furnace feed.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Fine mineral particles separated during dry sorting of Ironstone. This is ordinary mineral stock with an unresolved downstream use, not the airborne energy-bearing dust accepted by the Arc refinery.
decisions.name: Mineral Dust
decisions.description: Fine mineral particles separated during dry sorting of Ironstone. This is ordinary mineral stock with an unresolved downstream use, not the airborne energy-bearing dust accepted by the Arc refinery.
decisions.reason: An authored sorting byproduct whose downstream use is unresolved. No composition or useful stock grade distinguishes it beyond particle size. It is ordinary mineral fines, not Airborne Dust. Removal requires review of its existing Unity variant and multi-output dry-sort recipe.

decisions.previousDescription: The sand-sized fraction separated during dry sorting of Ironstone. It is stored independently from coarse aggregate and mineral dust so later processing can use the appropriate grain size; a specific downstream recipe is not yet assigned.
decisions.name: Mineral Sand
decisions.description: The sand-sized fraction separated during dry sorting of Ironstone. It is stored independently from coarse aggregate and mineral dust so later processing can use the appropriate grain size; a specific downstream recipe is not yet assigned.
decisions.reason: An authored sand-sized sorting fraction with no selected fabrication use or qualified grade. Do not invent a glassmaking composition from grain size. Removal requires review of its existing Unity variant and multi-output dry-sort recipe.

decisions.previousDescription: Intermediate feed for an eventual furnace. It is intended to enter a controlled metal-preparation or refining process; the feed material is distinct from the usable metal eventually produced.
decisions.name: Selected iron-ore furnace feed
decisions.description: Iron-bearing mineral feed selected and prepared from the magnetite-rich stone or hematite routes under consideration. It is a furnace input awaiting reduction, not metal stock. Keep it distinct from the existing Ironstone concentrate only while its source preparation remains a meaningful separate design choice.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Repair stock, fasteners and structural tool parts. It provides candidate material or a shaped starting piece for making other objects, with the final form set by the receiving design.
decisions.name: Consolidated iron bar stock
decisions.description: Worked iron consolidated into unfitted bars for fasteners, tool bodies and structural fittings. It is the metal-working stage after an iron bloom or selected ore has been processed, rather than another grade of loose ore. Final section, grade and forging conditions remain to be chosen.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Tool sharpening and surface preparation. It is intended to prepare or change a workpiece’s surface before a later fitting, coating or use; the treatment must suit that material.
decisions.name: Graded sharpening grit
decisions.description: Selected abrasive mineral grains sorted into a working size range for sharpening and surface preparation. The loose grit can be used in a compatible finishing process or incorporated into a bonded abrasive blank; grain composition and useful cutting behavior still require qualification.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Grounding-kit spacers and heat-resistant fixtures. It is intended to separate conductive parts or support them without a direct conducting path. No voltage or thermal rating follows from that proposed role.
decisions.name: Fired insulating ceramic blanks
decisions.description: Rough fired ceramic pieces reserved for later grinding into spacers, separators and supporting fittings. They are general blanks rather than fitted components. Their intended electrical-separation role does not assign a voltage, heat or chemical-service rating.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Dry composite repair and construction. It is intended to join, reinforce or support other parts, with the bond or fastening chosen for the materials and loads involved.
decisions.name: Calcined mineral binder powder
decisions.description: A prepared mineral powder obtained by controlled treatment of carbonate feed. It is proposed as an input to dry composite and construction-binder development; its name does not assume free water, a conventional mortar recipe or a qualified bond.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Dry lubricant; conductive composite ingredient. It is intended to reduce friction at a matched contact surface; dust behavior and material compatibility require qualification.
decisions.name: Graded graphite flake stock
decisions.description: Graphite-bearing feed prepared into selected flakes for dry-lubricant mixtures and conductive-material development. This is loose carbon stock, distinct from the later bonded electrode plates. Purity, flake size and the receiving formulation remain design choices.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Solid carbon fuel and possible metallurgical feedstock. It is proposed as a material energy input for controlled hot work. The receiving process must establish ignition, handling and a suitable working atmosphere.
decisions.name: Charcoal
decisions.description: Solid carbon fuel and possible metallurgical feedstock. It is proposed as a material energy input for controlled hot work. The receiving process must establish ignition, handling and a suitable working atmosphere.
decisions.reason: The generic charcoal record overlaps the retained, explicitly sourced Chitin-char entry: both proposed routes carbonize shell-derived feed. A separate tendon-based carbon grade is not yet justified. Propose removing or consolidating this umbrella row only after its ingredient links are redirected; no wood source is permitted.

decisions.previousDescription: Selected broken fired ceramic, sorted and crushed for candidate body mixes. It is intended for a matched glassworking or ceramic process, with composition, forming and controlled heat determining the useful result.
decisions.name: Graded fired-ceramic grog
decisions.description: Selected broken fired ceramic crushed and graded into reusable ceramic-body aggregate. It provides a prepared granular addition to a chosen body mix, rather than an intact ceramic fitting. Composition, grain range and the mixture receiving it remain unresolved.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Selected mineral feed blended for a chosen ceramic product. It is intended for a matched glassworking or ceramic process, with composition, forming and controlled heat determining the useful result.
decisions.name: Blended ceramic forming feed
decisions.description: A measured candidate blend of prepared mineral ingredients for shaping a chosen ceramic body. It is unfired feed whose recipe must suit the intended vessel, blank or panel. This broad forming blend remains distinct from the more specific fine kaolin formulation.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Selected mineral finishing feed for compatible ceramic surfaces. It is intended for a matched glassworking or ceramic process, with composition, forming and controlled heat determining the useful result.
decisions.name: Prepared ceramic glaze powder
decisions.description: A blended mineral finishing powder proposed for application to a compatible ceramic surface before controlled firing. It supplies an unfused surface-treatment feed, not an already glazed object. Formulation, application medium, firing conditions and contents compatibility remain open.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Carbonized chitin material described in the chitin source record. It is proposed as a material energy input for controlled hot work. The receiving process must establish ignition, handling and a suitable working atmosphere.
decisions.name: Carbonized husk char
decisions.description: Carbonized chitin-bearing husk pieces proposed as a prepared carbon input for hot-work and fuel research. The biological source distinguishes this material from wood charcoal, which the setting does not supply. Conversion conditions, usable carbon grade and behavior in the atmosphere still require design.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared metal stock in the form of smelted iron bloom, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It is intended to enter a controlled metal-preparation or refining process; the feed material is distinct from the usable metal eventually produced.
decisions.name: Unconsolidated iron bloom
decisions.description: A rough mass of iron-bearing metal from the proposed smelting stage, awaiting consolidation into usable working stock. It precedes the consolidated iron bars and steel-making branches. Metal yield, entrained residue and the required working process remain unqualified.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared metal stock in the form of refined copper cake, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It is intended to form part of a continuous conducting path, with section, joints and protection matched to the receiving circuit.
decisions.name: Refined copper cake
decisions.description: Copper gathered into a compact rough cake after the proposed first refining stage. The cake is working feed for drawing or forming conductors and small metal parts, rather than finished wire. Purity and later forming conditions remain to be established.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared metal stock in the form of reclaimed brass billet, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It provides candidate material or a shaped starting piece for making other objects, with the final form set by the receiving design.
decisions.name: Reclaimed brass billet
decisions.description: Recovered brass selected and consolidated into an unfitted billet for later shaping. It provides a coherent working blank instead of a mixed handful of scrap. Alloy consistency, contamination and the practical reclaiming process remain unresolved.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared metal stock in the form of reclaimed bronze billet, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It provides candidate material or a shaped starting piece for making other objects, with the final form set by the receiving design.
decisions.name: Reclaimed bronze billet
decisions.description: Recovered bronze prepared as a solid working billet for strips, bearing blanks and other shaped parts. It remains bulk metal stock with no fitted interfaces. The recovered alloy must be identified before a particular forming process or service use is chosen.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared glass stock in the form of opaque mineral-glass stock, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It is intended for a matched glassworking or ceramic process, with composition, forming and controlled heat determining the useful result.
decisions.name: Unformed opaque glass stock
decisions.description: Opaque glass prepared as rough solid stock for subsequent forming into sheets, linings or other glass blanks. This is the unshaped stage before the flat opaque-sheet entry. Composition, reheating conditions and usable material yield remain open.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared glass stock in the form of rough clear-glass blank, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It supports looking at or examining a workpiece, with the useful view determined by its optical and mechanical arrangement.

decisions.description: Rough glass pieces selected for possible transparent viewing elements. They precede sized viewing blanks and ground optics, with surfaces and shape still unfinished. Transparency is a selection aim, not a guarantee of optical quality or corrective performance.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared mineral stock in the form of dressed building-stone stock, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It is intended to join, reinforce or support other parts, with the bond or fastening chosen for the materials and loads involved.
decisions.name: Dressed stone blocks
decisions.description: Stone worked into rough blocks with usable faces for later fitted construction or mounting work. Dressing supplies a manageable stock form without making every block interchangeable. Source stone, dimensions, joining method and load suitability remain to be selected.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared mineral stock in the form of selected resonant-stone blank, intended as an input to further making or assembly. Its recorded physical form is intended to produce, control or support sound in a musical instrument; tuning and playable dimensions remain open.
decisions.name: Selected resonant stone blanks
decisions.description: Stone pieces selected as candidate sound-producing blanks before final shaping and acoustic matching. They provide the starting stock for tuned stone bars or instrument elements. Mineral choice, defects and useful sound response remain to be assessed.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared mineral stock in the form of prepared mineral pigment powder, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It supplies a visible ornamental surface or detail, with its placement and cultural meaning left to the receiving object’s design.

decisions.description: Mineral colorant ground into a prepared powder for decorative coatings and marking mixtures. It supplies the solid pigment fraction before a compatible carrier is added. Color consistency, particle grade and application properties remain design questions.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared mineral stock in the form of graded mineral filler, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It is intended to join, reinforce or support other parts, with the bond or fastening chosen for the materials and loads involved.
decisions.name: Graded mineral filler powder
decisions.description: Selected mineral particles prepared as a controlled filler for candidate binders and composite mixes. The filler changes the body of a receiving formulation rather than acting as a complete adhesive itself. Grain range, composition and the intended mix remain unresolved.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared glass stock in the form of sorted glass remelt feed, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It is intended for a matched glassworking or ceramic process, with composition, forming and controlled heat determining the useful result.
decisions.name: Sorted glass cullet
decisions.description: Broken glass selected and sorted into remelt feed for a compatible glass batch. It is prepared secondary material rather than reusable intact glazing. Mixed compositions, coatings and contamination must be resolved before a batch can be treated as a useful grade.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared mineral stock in the form of separated mica flake grade, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It provides candidate material or a shaped starting piece for making other objects, with the final form set by the receiving design.
decisions.name: Separated mica flake stock
decisions.description: Mica separated into loose flakes for composite sheets and other layered-material trials. This is particulate mineral feed before bonding, distinct from intact mica viewing sheets. Flake size, binder choice and the resulting material behavior remain open.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared husk fiber stock in the form of prepared husk-fiber pulp, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It supplies candidate fibers or prepared feed for husk-based paper, which must still be processed and formed into a usable sheet.
decisions.name: Prepared husk-fiber paper furnish
decisions.description: Scraped husk fibers cleaned and conditioned into feed ready for a proposed paper-forming process. It identifies the prepared fiber stage without assuming a water-based slurry. Sheet formation, compatible processing medium and yield remain to be designed.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared faunal fiber stock in the form of clean graded bristle bundles, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It is intended to obstruct grit at an opening or moving interface. Its fit and wear must be qualified before any exclusion or filtration performance is assigned.
decisions.name: Cleaned brush-bristle bundles
decisions.description: Faunal bristles cleaned, sorted and bundled as feed for brush strips and grit-exclusion fittings. Their useful form is a controlled set of working fibers rather than loose gathered bristles. Retention, stiffness and wear require qualification in the receiving assembly.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared shell / chitin stock in the form of separated shell lamina stock, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It provides candidate stock for a protective assembly, with coverage, joining and backing still determining the finished protection.
decisions.name: Separated shell lamina sheets
decisions.description: Thin layers separated and prepared from bulk shell husks for later lamination or shaping. These sheets are intermediate shell stock, distinct from assembled armor panels and from loose raw plates. Thickness, preparation and bonding remain unresolved.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared faunal hard tissue stock in the form of shaped fauna hard-part blanks, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It supplies a candidate working blank, edge or fitted part for a tool; shaping and mounting depend on the intended job.
decisions.name: Shaped faunal hard-part blanks
decisions.description: Faunal hard tissue selected and roughly shaped into solid blanks for tool edges, wear inserts or small fittings. Each blank still needs a chosen working profile and mounting. Source anatomy and useful material behavior remain subject to the existing biological limits.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared mineral stock in the form of graded process salts, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It is a candidate industrial input or process aid. Its composition, containment and compatible treatment must be established; usefulness does not imply edibility.
decisions.name: Graded industrial salt feed
decisions.description: Mineral salts selected and graded for proposed industrial processing mixtures. This is a controlled feed grade rather than an unidentified raw salt crust. Composition and process compatibility remain unresolved, and this entry supplies no food-grade or edible-salt claim.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared gemstone stock in the form of cut gemstone preform, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It supplies a visible ornamental surface or detail, with its placement and cultural meaning left to the receiving object’s design.
decisions.name: Rough-cut gemstone blanks
decisions.description: Gemstone pieces cut into rough preforms for later polishing, setting or inlay work. The cutting stage establishes a usable starting shape while leaving the final finish and fitting unfinished. Gem grade, loss during working and individual dimensions remain open.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared gemstone stock in the form of graded stone inlay chips, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It supplies a visible ornamental surface or detail, with its placement and cultural meaning left to the receiving object’s design.
decisions.name: Graded gemstone inlay chips
decisions.description: Small stone fragments selected by workable size for decorative inlay mixtures and fitted patterns. They are loose ornamental stock rather than finished jewelry or set panels. Color selection, setting method and compatible binding material remain undecided.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared shell / chitin stock in the form of burnished shell inlay scales, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It supplies a visible ornamental surface or detail, with its placement and cultural meaning left to the receiving object’s design.
decisions.name: Burnished shell inlay blanks
decisions.description: Thin shell pieces with prepared visible faces, reserved for cutting and fitting into ornamental surfaces. They remain loose inlay stock before a pattern or receiving object is chosen. Final dimensions, retention and surface finish remain design work.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared mineral stock in the form of sized mica viewing sheet, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It supports looking at or examining a workpiece, with the useful view determined by its optical and mechanical arrangement.
decisions.name: Sized mica viewing sheets
decisions.description: Intact mica sheets selected and cut to manageable sizes for proposed viewing openings. They retain their natural layered form instead of being reduced to flakes and rebound. Usable clarity, mounting, thickness and service conditions remain unqualified.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared insulating material family for electrical equipment and protective wear; composition unresolved.
decisions.name: Composite insulation blanks
decisions.description: Unfitted composite blanks proposed from prepared mica layers, ceramic pieces and compatible binding material. They provide stock for later electrical separators or shaped barriers, giving the insulation family a concrete intermediate form. Composition, geometry and electrical or thermal ratings remain unresolved.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Manufactured steel stock for later fabrication. It provides candidate material or a shaped starting piece for making other objects, with the final form set by the receiving design.
decisions.name: Unfitted steel stock
decisions.description: Steel prepared as general working stock for subsequent forming into parts, sheets and specialist grades. It is distinct from consolidated iron and from later spring-grade or finished-section steel. Exact composition, supplied section and production conditions remain to be chosen.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared mineral stock in the form of graded refractory mineral feed, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It is intended for a matched glassworking or ceramic process, with composition, forming and controlled heat determining the useful result.
decisions.name: Graded refractory mineral powder
decisions.description: Selected heat-work mineral feed ground and graded before forming a refractory body. It supplies a prepared input to ceramic linings and hot-work blanks, not an already fired protective part. Composition and performance at the intended service conditions remain unqualified.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.description: Manganese-bearing mineral material selected into a candidate refining and alloy-preparation feed. It precedes the prepared metal alloying addition, so collecting this stock does not supply alloy-ready manganese metal. Source composition and extraction remain unresolved.

decisions.previousDescription: Prepared metal stock in the form of prepared manganese alloying stock, intended as an input to further making or assembly. It is intended to enter a controlled metal-preparation or refining process; the feed material is distinct from the usable metal eventually produced.
decisions.name: Prepared manganese alloying addition
decisions.description: A processed metal-bearing addition prepared from the selected manganese-feed route for a proposed steel-making batch. It is a controlled alloy input rather than raw mineral feed or finished steel. Actual composition, addition rate and process compatibility remain undecided.
decisions.reason: Retain a specific prepared material form for subsequent fitting or fabrication.

decisions.name: Drawn copper wire stock

decisions.name: Bronze bearing blanks
decisions.description: Bronze stock shaped into rough blanks intended for later boring and fitting as bearing surfaces. These are machining inputs rather than working bearings. Alloy, clearance, lubrication and the load of the receiving mechanism remain unqualified.

decisions.name: Fired refractory ceramic blanks
decisions.description: Prepared refractory feed formed and fired into rough blanks for hot-work linings and supports. This is the fired stock stage after the graded mineral powder, before a final fitting is made. Heat cycling, atmosphere and useful service limits require qualification.
